Ambience includes wind, market voices and terminal hums. Effects includes footsteps and interface sounds.
Bark captions subtitle what colonists say as you pass. Conversations always show their text.
Dust of the Giants  /  Dust of Alshain
Resolution sets the size of the game window.
Lower render scale improves performance while keeping the interface sharp. Post-processing controls the city’s bloom and colour grading.
VSync follows your monitor’s refresh rate and takes priority over the frame limit.
The mouse turns the camera whenever no window is open. Hold Left Alt to free the pointer for the HUD; any open window frees it too.
Camera shake follows shots, hits taken and nearby wrecks. Reduced motion (Sound tab) turns it off.

The conversation camera frames whoever you talk to over your shoulder and moves the conversation to the bottom of the screen. Adaptive fades the colonist panel, Field Notes, event log and key hints after a few quiet seconds; each returns when it changes, in combat, while a window is open and while Left Alt is held.
